page_title: INT 0-1 ACM | Inter v AC Milan 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+3' Andy Diouf (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Inter earn a corner.
90+2' Marcus Thuram (Inter) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
88' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is flagged for offside.
88' Andy Diouf (Inter) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Mike Maignan is alert and makes a decent save.
87' Federico Dimarco (Inter) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
86' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) has come on for Rafael Leao.
85' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Nicolo Barella and he is replaced by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andy Diouf (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Francesco Acerbi.
84' Nicolo Barella (Inter) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
83' Nicolo Barella (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Maignan, who smothers the ball.

81' Manuel Akanji (Inter) gets to the ball from the resulting corner kick and attempts to curl it past the keeper. His wild shot sails wide of the goal. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
81' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
81' Petar Sucic (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
80' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
78' A substitution has been made. Christian Pulisic is replaced by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan).
78' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a change. Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) replaces Youssouf Fofana.
78' Substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu makes way for Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
76' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Federico Dimarco (Inter).
76' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
76' Petar Sucic (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
75' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
74' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

74' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan leaps out to thwart his attempt. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
72' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
72' It’s a PENALTY to Inter after the VAR review!
71' Referee Simone Sozza makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Inter. Let’s see what happens!
70' Marcus Thuram (Inter) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
68' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
68' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
68' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
67' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Yann Sommer punches the ball away.
66' The linesman raises his flag. Marcus Thuram (Inter) is adjudged offside.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lautaro Martinez departs the field of play to be replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
65' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
63' Nicolo Barella (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
62' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
61' The main referee, Simone Sozza, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is given a yellow card for dissent.
61' Carlos Augusto (Inter) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

59' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
59' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
58' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Christian Pulisic.
56' Some patient build-up play from AC Milan as they look to unlock the defence.
54' 0 - 1 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:1.
53' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
53' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is adjudged offside.
51' Marcus Thuram (Inter) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Mike Maignan.
51' Marcus Thuram (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
50' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Federico Dimarco (Inter), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

50' A lofted cross from Nicolo Barella (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Inter have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
48' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45+2' Simone Sozza shows the yellow card to Rafael Leao (AC Milan) for a heavy challenge.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.

41' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
38' A cross from Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.

37' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper made a brilliant save and deflected the ball onto the post.
36' Carlos Augusto (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
33' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) makes a strong challenge and Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
31' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

29' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
27' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Francesco Acerbi (Inter) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the left post!
26' The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.

26' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.

24' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
22' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
20' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan).

16' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.

16' Petar Sucic (Inter) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
15' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner which is cleared.
15' Federico Dimarco (Inter) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Inter.
13' A quickly taken corner by Inter.
13' The ball is cleared after Petar Sucic (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman makes the right call and Inter will have a corner.
11' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
9' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
7' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Simone Sozza blows his whistle. Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) commits a foul after dangerous play.
4' What a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Mike Maignan dived superbly to deny Marcus Thuram (Inter), whose header was directed to the bottom right corner.
3' Nicolo Barella (Inter) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
2' The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.
2' Marcus Thuram (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.
1' The first half has started.
Inter will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Simone Sozza.
